name: Sniptide
description: Pastebin for code, configs and secrets, with an MCP server for your AI agents.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The database (postgres/) with every paste, and the secret keys (state/). Back up the whole folder: without state/secrets.env, stored environment secrets can't be read.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Sniptide web app, API and MCP endpoint, published on host as 6716

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUBLIC_URL
variables.description: Required. Replace YOUR-SERVER-IP with your server IP, like http://192.168.1.20:6716, or use your https domain. Sign-in only works on this address, and share links use it.
